import os

# Verify crucible_hidden has all required files
files = sorted(os.listdir('crucible_hidden'))
print(f"Files in crucible_hidden: {files}")

# Count total tests
total_tests = 0
for f in files:
    if f.startswith('test_') and f.endswith('.py'):
        with open(f'crucible_hidden/{f}') as fh:
            content = fh.read()
        tests = [l for l in content.split('\n') if l.strip().startswith('def test_')]
        total_tests += len(tests)
        print(f"  {f}: {len(tests)} tests")

print(f"\nTotal test functions: {total_tests}")
print(f"All tests verified to fail (9 failed, 0 passed)")

# Run final pytest to confirm
r = await world.call('repo.shell', command='python -m pytest crucible_hidden/ -v --tb=no 2>&1 | grep -E "(PASSED|FAILED|ERROR)" | head -20')
print(f"\nTest outcomes:\n{r['content']}")
